title: Quote card and request
summary: The customer taps Pedir orçamento in the chat with a business; the business answers with a quote card pinned in the chat, drawn from the API, with Aceitar (into a booking or an order) and Recusar, and older versions readable (ADR 0106).

status.description: From bipe-api; expired when the current version's validity passed.

currentVersion.description: The version that can be accepted.

lines.description: Lines of the version on screen: name, quantity, unit price, line total.

totalCents.description: Total of the version on screen.

validUntil.description: Validity of the version on screen.

visitServiceId.description: A catálogo service to book a visit for.

shownVersion.description: The version on screen; older ones open from bipe_quote_previous_versions.

ownerMode.description: true on the company side: Enviar nova versão instead of Aceitar and Recusar.

request.effect: POST /v1/businesses/{business}/quotes/requests, then bipe_quote_requested. The description and photos go in the chat as messages.

acceptOrder.effect: POST .../quotes/{id}/accept with target order, pickup or delivery, in_person. Shows the order card after.

acceptBooking.effect: Opens agenda-book with the visit service; its confirm calls accept with target booking and the chosen time instead of hold.

showVersion.effect: Shows an older version, read only.

revise.effect: Owner: opens quote-builder for a new version.

notes: A business cannot send a quote without a request (ADR 0037, ADR 0106).
Pix charges on accept wait for Pix charge cards (ADR 0080); the app offers pay on site only. Bipe moves no money (ADR 0012).
Amounts are BRL in centavos from the API, shown with the phone's locale.
